messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Unreliable and repetitive save actions",
 "problem_statement": "Users are forced to perform repetitive and unreliable save actions across various sections of the platform. This friction causes frustration and delays because the system fails to provide immediate confirmation or requires excessive clicks to complete basic tasks.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "Documents: click \"Document type\", rage x5\nDocuments: click \"Open\"",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-05T14:45:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Documents: click \"Document type\", rage x5\nDocuments: click \"Save\"",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-14T15:35:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Documents: click \"Open\"\nDocuments: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-16T10:04:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Documents: click \"Document type\", rage x5\nDocuments: click \"Open\"",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-23T09:05:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Claim details: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-28T14:00:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Tasks: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-10-22T16:10:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Suppliers: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-09T14:19:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Tasks: click \"Details\"\nTasks: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-06T10:17:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Documents: click \"Document type\", rage x5",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-03T12:51:00Z"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that save actions across multiple sections (Documents, Claim details, Tasks, Suppliers) are unreliable and require excessive clicks. The session quotes consistently show rage clicks on 'Save' and 'Document type' across different routes and dates, indicating a recurring in-product usability problem rather than an external cause. No quote suggests pricing, contracts, customer IT, or a help-article answer, and none is praise. A squad could plausibly act on improving save feedback and reducing redundant clicks.", "verdict": "pass"}
